x: Twenty jamʿahs. The sea petitioned, the elements recalled, the whole of Yā-Sīn the walls of Yā-Sīn , and the house built of Names.

Calls on the Names, asks for protection (ʿiṣma) over every movement, stillness, word, intention and passing thought, then makes the petitions of the sea. The ḥubb amal is inserted after the seventeenfold request for a fair wind.

Ḥubb amal li-jalb al-maḥabbah — the fair wind — 12 / 7 / 5 · 12 days
Rabṭ al-alsunah the tying of the tongues — wa-ṭmis ʿalā wujūhi aʿdāʾinā — 3 daily · 12 days
Li-fitnah the resolution of strife — fa’Llāhu khayrun ḥāfiẓan — 17 daily · 3 days

يَا اللَّهُ يَا عَلِيُّ يَاعَظِيمُ يَاحَلِيمُ يَاعَلِيمُ ❁ أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَعِلْمُكَ حَسْبِي ❁ فَنِعْمَ الرَّبُّ رَبِّي وَنِعْمَ الْحَسْبُ حَسْبِي ❁ تَنْصُرُ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَأَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ ❁
Yā Allāhu yā ʿAliyyu yā ʿAẓīmu yā Ḥalīmu yā ʿAlīm. Anta rabbī wa ʿilmuka ḥasbī. Fa-niʿma’r-rabbu rabbī wa niʿma’l-ḥasbu ḥasbī. Tanṣuru man tashāʾu wa anta’l-ʿAzīzu’r-Raḥīm.

O Allāh, O Most High, O Immense, O Forbearing, O All-Knowing. You are my Lord, and Your knowledge is my sufficiency. How excellent a Lord is my Lord, and how excellent a sufficiency is my sufficiency. You give victory to whom You will, and You are the Mighty, the Compassionate.
نَسْأَلُكَ الْعِصْمَةَ فِي الْحَرَكَاتِ وَالسَّكَنَاتِ وَالْكَلِمَاتِ وَالْإِرَادَاتِ وَالْخَطَرَاتِ مِنَ الشُّكُوكِ وَالظُّنُونِ وَالْأَوْهَامِ السَّاتِرَةِ لِلْقُلُوبِ عَنْ مُطَالَعَةِ الْغُيُوبِ ❁
Nasʾaluka’l-ʿiṣmata fi’l-ḥarakāti wa’s-sakanāti wa’l-kalimāti wa’l-irādāti wa’l-khaṭarāti mina’sh-shukūki wa’ẓ-ẓunūni wa’l-awhāmi’s-sātirati li’l-qulūbi ʿan muṭālaʿati’l-ghuyūb.

We ask You for preservation in our movements and our stillnesses, in our words, our intentions and the thoughts that cross the heart — from doubts, from suspicions, and from the fancies that veil hearts from the beholding of the unseen.
فَقَدِ
Fa-qadi…
For indeed —

﴿ ٱبْتُلِىَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوا۟ زِلْزَالًا شَدِيدًا ❁ وَإِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ مَّا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ إِلَّا غُرُورًا ❁ ﴾ Q 33 : 11 – 12
…ubtuliya’l-muʾminūna wa zulzilū zilzālan shadīdā. Wa idh yaqūlu’l-munāfiqūna wa’lladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun mā waʿadana’llāhu wa rasūluhū illā ghurūrā.
…the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking. And when the hypocrites, and those in whose hearts is sickness, said: Allāh and His Messenger promised us nothing but delusion.

فَثَبِّتْنَا وَانْصُرْنَا وَسَخِّرْ لَنَا هَذَا الْبَحْرَ ١ كَمَا سَخَّرْتَ الْبَحْرَ لِمُوسَى ❁ وَسَخَّرْتَ النَّارَ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ ❁ وَسَخَّرْتَ الْجِبَالَ وَالْحَدِيدَ لِدَاوُدَ ❁ وَسَخَّرْتَ الرِّيحَ وَالشَّيَاطِينَ وَالْجِنَّ لِسُلَيْمَانَ ❁ وَسَخَّرْتَ الْمُلْكَ وَالْمَلَكُوتَ لِنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ش ❁

Fa-thabbitnā wa’nṣurnā wa sakhkhir lanā hādha’l-baḥr, kamā sakhkharta’l-baḥra li-Mūsā, wa sakhkharta’n-nāra li-Ibrāhīm, wa sakhkharta’l-jibāla wa’l-ḥadīda li-Dāwūd, wa sakhkharta’r-rīḥa wa’sh-shayāṭīna wa’l-jinna li-Sulaymān, wa sakhkharta’l-mulka wa’l-malakūta li-nabiyyinā Muḥammadin ṣalla’llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam.

So make us firm, and give us victory, and make this sea subject to us — as You made the sea subject to Mūsā, and the fire to Ibrāhīm, and the mountains and the iron to Dāwūd, and the wind and the shayāṭīn and the jinn to Sulaymān, and the kingdom and the dominion to our Prophet Muḥammad, may Allāh bless him and grant him peace.

وَسَخِّرْ لَنَا كُلَّ بَحْرٍ ٢ هُوَ لَكَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ وَالْمُلْكِ وَالْمَلَكُوتِ ❁ وَبَحْرَ الدُّنْيَا وَبَحْرَ الْآخِرَةِ ❁ وَسَخِّرْ لَنَا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ ٣ ❁ يَا مَنْ بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ ❁
Wa sakhkhir lanā kulla baḥrin huwa laka fi’l-arḍi wa’s-samāʾi wa’l-mulki wa’l-malakūt, wa baḥra’d-dunyā wa baḥra’l-ākhirah. Wa sakhkhir lanā kulla shayʾ. Yā man bi-yadihī malakūtu kulli shayʾ.

And make subject to us every sea that is Yours — in earth and in heaven, in kingdom and in dominion — and the sea of this world and the sea of the next. And make every thing subject to us. O You in whose hand is the dominion of every thing.
Kāf Hā Yā ʿAyn Ṣād — three times.
Kāf Hā Yā ʿAyn Ṣād — the disjoined letters that open Sūrat Maryam, left untranslated as they stand.

اُنْصُرْنَا فَإِنَّكَ خَيْرُ النَّاصِرِينَ ❁ وَافْتَحْ لَنَا فَإِنَّكَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ ❁ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا فَإِنَّكَ خَيْرُ الْغَافِرِينَ ❁ وَارْحَمْنَا فَإِنَّكَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ ❁ وَارْزُقْنَا فَإِنَّكَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ ❁ وَاهْدِنَا وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ ❁

Unṣurnā fa-innaka khayru’n-nāṣirīn. Wa’ftaḥ lanā fa-innaka khayru’l-fātiḥīn. Wa’ghfir lanā fa-innaka khayru’l-ghāfirīn. Wa’rḥamnā fa-innaka khayru’r-rāḥimīn. Wa’rzuqnā fa-innaka khayru’r-rāziqīn. Wa’hdinā wa najjinā mina’l-qawmi’ẓ-ẓālimīn.

Give us victory, for You are the best of helpers. Open for us, for You are the best of openers. Forgive us, for You are the best of forgivers. Have mercy on us, for You are the most merciful of the merciful. Provide for us, for You are the best of providers. Guide us, and deliver us from the wrongdoing people.
وَهَبْ لَنَا رِيحًا طَيِّبَةً ١٧
Wa hab lanā rīḥan ṭayyibah.
And grant us a fair wind.
Twelve, seven or five recitations by urgency, over rose-water · twelve days · pause here and repeat the fair wind seventeen times
﴿ يُحِبُّونَهُمْ كَحُبِّ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَشَدُّ حُبًّا لِّلَّهِ ❁ ﴾
Yuḥibbūnahum ka-ḥubbi’llāh, wa’lladhīna āmanū ashaddu ḥubban li’llāh.
They love them as Allāh should be loved — but those who believe are stronger in love for Allāh.
“They love them as the love due to God; but those who believe are stronger in love for God.” — Q 2:165
Then say: “O God, create love and friendship of so-and-so son of so-and-so within the heart of so-and-so son of so-and-so . Amen.”

كَمَا هِيَ فِي عِلْمِكَ ❁ وَانْشُرْهَا عَلَيْنَا مِنْ خَزَائِنِ رَحْمَتِكَ ❁ وَاحْمِلْنَا بِهَا حَمْلَ الْكَرَامَةِ مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ وَالْعَافِيَّةِ فِي الدِّينِ وَالدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ ❁ إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ❁
Kamā hiya fī ʿilmik. Wa’nshurhā ʿalaynā min khazāʾini raḥmatik. Wa’ḥmilnā bihā ḥamla’l-karāmati maʿa’s-salāmati wa’l-ʿāfiyati fi’d-dīni wa’d-dunyā wa’l-ākhirah. Innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.

As it is in Your knowledge. And unfurl it over us out of the treasuries of Your mercy. And carry us by it with the carrying of honour, together with safety and wellbeing in religion, in this world and in the next. You have power over all things.

اللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ لَنَا أُمُورَنَا ٤ مَعَ الرَّاحَةِ لِقُلُوبِنَا وَأَبْدَانِنَا وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْعَافِيَةِ فِي دِينِنَا وَدُنْيَانَا ❁ وَكُنْ لَنَا صَاحِبًا فِي سَفَرِنَا وَخَلِيفَةً فِي أَهْلِنَا ❁
Allāhumma yassir lanā umūranā maʿa’r-rāḥati li-qulūbinā wa abdāninā wa’s-salāmati wa’l-ʿāfiyati fī dīninā wa dunyānā. Wa kun lanā ṣāḥiban fī safarinā wa khalīfatan fī ahlinā.

O Allāh, make our affairs easy for us, with rest for our hearts and our bodies, and safety and wellbeing in our religion and our world. And be a companion to us on our journey, and a deputy over those we leave behind.
Interlude
وَاطْمِسْ عَلَى وُجُوهِ أَعْدَائِنَا وَامْسَخْهُمْ عَلَى مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ الْمُضِيَّ وَلَا الْمَجِيءَ إِلَيْنَا ❁
Wa’ṭmis ʿalā wujūhi aʿdāʾinā wa’msakhhum ʿalā makānatihim fa-lā yastaṭīʿūna’l-muḍiyya wa la’l-majīʾa ilaynā.
And efface the faces of our enemies, and hold them fixed where they stand, so that they can neither advance nor come toward us.
Three recitations daily · twelve days · pause here, or at Shāhati al-wujūh , and repeat the phrase seventeen times
يَا قَاهِرُ ذَا الْبَطْشِ الشَّدِيدِ الَّذِي لَا يُطَاقُ انْتِقَامُهُ ❁ يَا قَاهِرُ خُذْ خُذْ ❁
Yā Qāhiru dha’l-baṭshi’sh-shadīdi’lladhī lā yuṭāqu’ntiqāmuh. Yā Qāhiru khudh khudh.
O Subduer, possessor of the severe assault whose retribution cannot be withstood. O Subduer: take, take.
“O Subduer, possessor of severe seizure, whose vengeance cannot be withstood; O Subduer, take, take.”
Then ask that a sevenfold wrath be brought upon so-and-so son of so-and-so , and that the eye, the tongue and the heart of the oppressor be turned away within twelve days.

The caution of the Shaykhs. Only against an actual oppressor, never against an innocent person. The litany carries within it a sword, which cuts whoever is liable to be cut; whoever turns it against an innocent has aimed it at himself. Shāh Walī Allāh, the Urdu translator and the editor each repeat this warning, because it is so often ignored.
The completion is a method for grave matters. Set aside here, the recital keeps only what the baseline Ḥizb carries: 66–67 at the effacement, and 1–9 at the walls.

The close of the sūra is taken first: these are the verses of effacement and transformation just asked for, ending on the dominion of all things being in His hand. The two verses of effacement and transformation, as the baseline recital has them — the completion to the end of the sūra is set aside.

﴿ وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ ❁ وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ ❁ ﴾ وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ ❁ وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ ❁ لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ ❁

Wa law nashāʾu la-ṭamasnā ʿalā aʿyunihim fa’stabaqu’ṣ-ṣirāṭa fa-annā yubṣirūn. Wa law nashāʾu la-masakhnāhum ʿalā makānatihim fa-mā’staṭāʿū muḍiyyan wa lā yarjiʿūn. Wa man nuʿammirhu nunakkis-hu fi’l-khalq, a-fa-lā yaʿqilūn. Wa mā ʿallamnāhu’sh-shiʿra wa mā yanbaghī lah, in huwa illā dhikrun wa qurʾānun mubīn. Li-yundhira man kāna ḥayyan wa yaḥiqqa’l-qawlu ʿala’l-kāfirīn.

Had We willed, We would have effaced their eyes, and they would have raced for the path — but how would they see? Had We willed, We would have fixed them where they stand, so they could neither go forward nor return. Whomever We grant long life, We reverse in creation; will they not understand? We did not teach him poetry, nor would it befit him. This is only a reminder and a clear recitation, to warn whoever is living, and that the word may fall due against the deniers.

أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ ❁ وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ ❁ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ ❁ وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ ❁ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ ❁ فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ ❁

A-wa-lam yaraw annā khalaqnā lahum mimmā ʿamilat aydīnā anʿāman fa-hum lahā mālikūn. Wa dhallalnāhā lahum fa-minhā rakūbuhum wa minhā yaʾkulūn. Wa lahum fīhā manāfiʿu wa mashārib, a-fa-lā yashkurūn. Wa’ttakhadhū min dūni’llāhi ālihatan laʿallahum yunṣarūn. Lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣrahum wa hum lahum jundun muḥḍarūn. Fa-lā yaḥzunka qawluhum, innā naʿlamu mā yusirrūna wa mā yuʿlinūn.

Have they not seen that We created for them, out of what Our hands have made, livestock which they own? We made them tractable for them: some they ride and some they eat. In them are benefits and drinks. Will they not give thanks? Yet they have taken gods besides Allāh, hoping to be helped. Those can give them no help; rather they are a host brought up against them. So let their speech not grieve you. We know what they conceal and what they proclaim.

أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ ❁ وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ ❁ قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ ❁ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ ❁ أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ❁ إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ ❁ فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ ❁ ﴾

A-wa-lam yara’l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min nuṭfatin fa-idhā huwa khaṣīmun mubīn. Wa ḍaraba lanā mathalan wa nasiya khalqah, qāla man yuḥyi’l-ʿiẓāma wa hiya ramīm. Qul yuḥyīha’lladhī anshaʾahā awwala marrah, wa huwa bi-kulli khalqin ʿalīm. Alladhī jaʿala lakum mina’sh-shajari’l-akhḍari nāran fa-idhā antum minhu tūqidūn. A-wa-laysa’lladhī khalaqa’s-samāwāti wa’l-arḍa bi-qādirin ʿalā an yakhluqa mithlahum, balā wa huwa’l-Khallāqu’l-ʿAlīm. Innamā amruhū idhā arāda shayʾan an yaqūla lahū kun fa-yakūn. Fa-subḥāna’lladhī bi-yadihī malakūtu kulli shayʾin wa ilayhi turjaʿūn.

Has man not seen that We created him from a drop — and there he is, an open adversary? He strikes a likeness for Us and forgets his own creation, saying: Who will give life to bones when they have decayed? Say: He will give them life who brought them into being the first time, and He knows every creation. He who made fire for you out of the green tree, and from it you kindle. Is not He who created the heavens and the earth able to create their like? Yes indeed — He is the Supreme Creator, the All-Knowing. His command, when He wills a thing, is only to say to it: Be — and it is. So glory be to Him in whose hand is the dominion of every thing, and to Him you are returned.
The sūra from its opening. Each occurrence of mubīn is set in blue, and the salām of verse 58 in gold. The nine opening verses, as the baseline recital has them — the walls of Yā-Sīn, and no further.

﴿ يسٓ ❁ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ ❁ إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ ❁ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ ❁ تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ❁ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ ❁ لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ ❁ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَـٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَـٰلًا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ ❁ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَأَغْشَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ ❁ ﴾

Yā Sīn. Wa’l-qurʾāni’l-ḥakīm. Innaka la-mina’l-mursalīn. ʿAlā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm. Tanzīla’l-ʿAzīzi’r-Raḥīm. Li-tundhira qawman mā undhira ābāʾuhum fa-hum ghāfilūn. Laqad ḥaqqa’l-qawlu ʿalā aktharihim fa-hum lā yuʾminūn. Innā jaʿalnā fī aʿnāqihim aghlālan fa-hiya ila’l-adhqāni fa-hum muqmaḥūn. Wa jaʿalnā min bayni aydīhim saddan wa min khalfihim saddan fa-aghshaynāhum fa-hum lā yubṣirūn.

Yā Sīn. By the Qurʾān, full of wisdom — you are indeed among the messengers, upon a straight path. A sending down from the Mighty, the Compassionate, that you may warn a people whose fathers were not warned, and who are therefore heedless. The word has fallen due against most of them, so they do not believe. We have set shackles on their necks reaching to the chins, so their heads are forced up. And We have set a barrier before them and a barrier behind them and covered them over, so they do not see.

وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ ❁ إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَأَجْرٍ كَرِيمٍ ❁ إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَـٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ ❁

Wa sawāʾun ʿalayhim a-andhartahum am lam tundhirhum lā yuʾminūn. Innamā tundhiru mani’ttabaʿa’dh-dhikra wa khashiya’r-Raḥmāna bi’l-ghayb, fa-bashshirhu bi-maghfiratin wa ajrin karīm. Innā naḥnu nuḥyi’l-mawtā wa naktubu mā qaddamū wa āthārahum, wa kulla shayʾin aḥṣaynāhu fī imāmin mubīn.

It is the same to them whether you warn them or do not warn them: they do not believe. You warn only one who follows the reminder and fears the All-Merciful unseen; give him glad tidings of forgiveness and a generous reward. It is We who give life to the dead, and record what they have sent ahead and the traces they leave. Every thing We have counted in a clear register.

وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ ❁ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ ❁ قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ ❁ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ ❁ وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ ❁ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ ❁ قَالُوا۟ طَـٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ ❁

Wa’ḍrib lahum mathalan aṣḥāba’l-qaryati idh jāʾaha’l-mursalūn. Idh arsalnā ilayhimu’thnayni fa-kadhdhabūhumā fa-ʿazzaznā bi-thālithin fa-qālū innā ilaykum mursalūn. Qālū mā antum illā basharun mithlunā wa mā anzala’r-Raḥmānu min shayʾin in antum illā takdhibūn. Qālū rabbunā yaʿlamu innā ilaykum la-mursalūn. Wa mā ʿalaynā illa’l-balāghu’l-mubīn. Qālū innā taṭayyarnā bikum, la-in lam tantahū la-narjumannakum wa la-yamassannakum minnā ʿadhābun alīm. Qālū ṭāʾirukum maʿakum, a-in dhukkirtum? Bal antum qawmun musrifūn.

Strike for them the likeness of the people of the town, when the messengers came to it. We sent two to them, and they denied them both, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said: We are sent to you. They said: You are only men like us; the All-Merciful has sent nothing down. You are only lying. They said: Our Lord knows that we are indeed sent to you, and nothing rests upon us but the clear delivery of the message. They said: We take you as an evil omen. If you do not stop, we will surely stone you, and a painful punishment from us will touch you. They said: Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? No — you are a people gone to excess.

وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ ❁ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ ❁ وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ ❁ ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ ❁ إِنِّىٓ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ ❁ إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ ❁ قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ ❁ بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ ❁

Wa jāʾa min aqṣa’l-madīnati rajulun yasʿā qāla yā qawmi’ttabiʿu’l-mursalīn. Ittabiʿū man lā yasʾalukum ajran wa hum muhtadūn. Wa mā liya lā aʿbudu’lladhī faṭaranī wa ilayhi turjaʿūn. A-attakhidhu min dūnihī ālihatan in yuridni’r-Raḥmānu bi-ḍurrin lā tughni ʿannī shafāʿatuhum shayʾan wa lā yunqidhūn. Innī idhan la-fī ḍalālin mubīn. Innī āmantu bi-rabbikum fa’smaʿūn. Qīla’dkhuli’l-jannah, qāla yā layta qawmī yaʿlamūn, bi-mā ghafara lī rabbī wa jaʿalanī mina’l-mukramīn.

And from the far side of the city a man came running. He said: My people, follow the messengers. Follow those who ask no reward of you, and who are themselves guided. Why should I not serve the One who brought me into being, and to whom you are returned? Shall I take gods besides Him — when, if the All-Merciful intends me harm, their intercession will avail me nothing and they cannot rescue me? Then I would be in plain error. I have believed in your Lord, so hear me. It was said: Enter the Garden. He said: If only my people knew how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honoured.

وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ ❁ إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ خَـٰمِدُونَ ❁ يَـٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ ❁ أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ ❁ وَإِن كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ ❁

Wa mā anzalnā ʿalā qawmihī min baʿdihī min jundin mina’s-samāʾi wa mā kunnā munzilīn. In kānat illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fa-idhā hum khāmidūn. Yā ḥasratan ʿala’l-ʿibād, mā yaʾtīhim min rasūlin illā kānū bihī yastahziʾūn. A-lam yaraw kam ahlaknā qablahum mina’l-qurūni annahum ilayhim lā yarjiʿūn. Wa in kullun lammā jamīʿun ladaynā muḥḍarūn.

We sent down no host from heaven against his people after him, nor were We to send one. It was but a single cry, and at once they were extinguished. What sorrow over the servants: no messenger comes to them but they mock him. Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, and that they do not return to them? Yet every one of them will be brought before Us together.

وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَـٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ ❁ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّـٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ ❁ لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ ❁ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ❁

Wa āyatun lahumu’l-arḍu’l-maytatu aḥyaynāhā wa akhrajnā minhā ḥabban fa-minhu yaʾkulūn. Wa jaʿalnā fīhā jannātin min nakhīlin wa aʿnābin wa fajjarnā fīhā mina’l-ʿuyūn. Li-yaʾkulū min thamarihī wa mā ʿamilat-hu aydīhim, a-fa-lā yashkurūn. Subḥāna’lladhī khalaqa’l-azwāja kullahā mimmā tunbitu’l-arḍu wa min anfusihim wa mimmā lā yaʿlamūn.

A sign for them is the dead earth: We gave it life and brought grain out of it, and from it they eat. We made in it gardens of date palms and vines, and caused springs to gush in it, that they might eat of its fruit — and their hands did not make it. Will they not give thanks? Glory to Him who created all the pairs: of what the earth grows, of themselves, and of what they do not know.

وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ ❁ وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ ❁ وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَـٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ ❁ لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ ❁

Wa āyatun lahumu’l-laylu naslakhu minhu’n-nahāra fa-idhā hum muẓlimūn. Wa’sh-shamsu tajrī li-mustaqarrin lahā, dhālika taqdīru’l-ʿAzīzi’l-ʿAlīm. Wa’l-qamara qaddarnāhu manāzila ḥattā ʿāda ka’l-ʿurjūni’l-qadīm. La’sh-shamsu yanbaghī lahā an tudrika’l-qamara wa la’l-laylu sābiqu’n-nahār, wa kullun fī falakin yasbaḥūn.

A sign for them is the night: We draw the day off from it, and at once they are in darkness. And the sun runs to a resting place appointed for it; that is the measuring of the Mighty, the All-Knowing. And the moon — We have measured out stations for it, until it returns like an old dry palm branch. The sun is not to overtake the moon, nor does the night outstrip the day; each swims in an orbit.

وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ ❁ وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ ❁ وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ ❁ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَـٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ ❁

Wa āyatun lahum annā ḥamalnā dhurriyyatahum fi’l-fulki’l-mashḥūn. Wa khalaqnā lahum min mithlihī mā yarkabūn. Wa in nashaʾ nughriqhum fa-lā ṣarīkha lahum wa lā hum yunqadhūn. Illā raḥmatan minnā wa matāʿan ilā ḥīn.

A sign for them is that We carried their offspring in the laden ship, and We created for them the like of it, on which they ride. If We willed, We could drown them — with none to hear their cry, and they would not be saved, except by a mercy from Us and enjoyment for a while.

وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ ❁ وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ مِّنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ ❁ وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ ❁ وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ ❁

Wa idhā qīla lahumu’ttaqū mā bayna aydīkum wa mā khalfakum laʿallakum turḥamūn. Wa mā taʾtīhim min āyatin min āyāti rabbihim illā kānū ʿanhā muʿriḍīn. Wa idhā qīla lahum anfiqū mimmā razaqakumu’llāhu qāla’lladhīna kafarū li’lladhīna āmanū a-nuṭʿimu man law yashāʾu’llāhu aṭʿamahū, in antum illā fī ḍalālin mubīn. Wa yaqūlūna matā hādha’l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn.

When it is said to them: Beware of what lies before you and what lies behind you, so that you may receive mercy — and no sign of their Lord's signs comes to them but they turn away from it. When it is said to them: Spend of what Allāh has provided you — those who disbelieve say to those who believe: Are we to feed one whom Allāh would have fed had He willed? You are only in plain error. And they say: When is this promise, if you are truthful?

مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ ❁ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ ❁ وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ ❁ قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ ❁ إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ ❁ فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ❁

Mā yanẓurūna illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan taʾkhudhuhum wa hum yakhiṣṣimūn. Fa-lā yastaṭīʿūna tawṣiyatan wa lā ilā ahlihim yarjiʿūn. Wa nufikha fi’ṣ-ṣūri fa-idhā hum mina’l-ajdāthi ilā rabbihim yansilūn. Qālū yā waylanā man baʿathanā min marqadinā? Hādhā mā waʿada’r-Raḥmānu wa ṣadaqa’l-mursalūn. In kānat illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fa-idhā hum jamīʿun ladaynā muḥḍarūn. Fa’l-yawma lā tuẓlamu nafsun shayʾan wa lā tujzawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūn.

They await only a single cry that will seize them while they are disputing. Then they will not be able to make a will, nor return to their people. The trumpet will be blown, and at once they will hasten from the graves to their Lord. They will say: Alas for us — who has raised us from our resting place? This is what the All-Merciful promised; the messengers spoke the truth. It will be but a single cry, and at once they will all be brought before Us. On that day no soul will be wronged in anything, and you will be repaid only for what you used to do.

إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ ❁ هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ ❁ لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ ❁ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ ❁
Inna aṣḥāba’l-jannati’l-yawma fī shughulin fākihūn. Hum wa azwājuhum fī ẓilālin ʿala’l-arāʾiki muttakiʾūn. Lahum fīhā fākihatun wa lahum mā yaddaʿūn. Salāmun qawlan min Rabbin Raḥīm.

The companions of the Garden are today happily occupied. They and their spouses are in shade, reclining upon couches. They have fruit there, and whatever they call for. “Peace” — a word from a Compassionate Lord.

وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ ❁ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ ❁ وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ ❁ وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ ❁ هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ ❁ ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ ❁ ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ ❁ ﴾

Wa’mtāzu’l-yawma ayyuha’l-mujrimūn. A-lam aʿhad ilaykum yā banī Ādama an lā taʿbudu’sh-shayṭān, innahū lakum ʿaduwwun mubīn. Wa ani’ʿbudūnī, hādhā ṣirāṭun mustaqīm. Wa laqad aḍalla minkum jibillan kathīran, a-fa-lam takūnū taʿqilūn. Hādhihī jahannamu’llatī kuntum tūʿadūn. Iṣlawha’l-yawma bi-mā kuntum takfurūn. Al-yawma nakhtimu ʿalā afwāhihim wa tukallimunā aydīhim wa tashhadu arjuluhum bi-mā kānū yaksibūn.

Stand apart today, you who did wrong. Did I not charge you, children of Ādam, not to serve Shayṭān — he is a clear enemy to you — and to serve Me? That is a straight path. He has led a great many of you astray; had you no sense? This is the Hell you were promised. Burn in it today for your denial. Today We seal their mouths; their hands speak to Us, and their feet bear witness to what they earned.
The disjoined letters, then the house built of Names — door, walls, roof, sufficiency, protection — and the four verses of reliance, each said three times.
شَاهَتِ الْوُجُوهُ ❁ ٣
Shāhati’l-wujūh — three times.
May the faces be disfigured — three times, the hand struck down toward the earth at each.
﴿ وَعَنَتِ ٱلْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَىِّ ٱلْقَيُّومِ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا ❁ ﴾ Q 20 : 111
Wa ʿanati’l-wujūhu li’l-Ḥayyi’l-Qayyūm, wa qad khāba man ḥamala ẓulmā.
Faces are humbled before the Living, the Self-Subsisting; and whoever carries wrongdoing has failed.
طسٓ ❁ حمٓ ❁ عٓسٓقٓ ❁
Ṭā Sīn. Ḥā Mīm. ʿAyn Sīn Qāf.
Ṭā Sīn · Ḥā Mīm · ʿAyn Sīn Qāf — the disjoined letters opening three sūras.
﴿ مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ ❁ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ ❁ ﴾ Q 55 : 19 – 20
Maraja’l-baḥrayni yaltaqiyān. Baynahumā barzakhun lā yabghiyān.
He has let the two seas flow, meeting together; between them is a barrier they do not overrun.
Ḥā Mīm — seven times.
Ḥā Mīm, seven times: one into each of the six directions, and the seventh blown into the hands.
One with each utterance — Ghāfir · Fuṣṣilat · al-Shūrā · al-Zukhruf · al-Dukhān · al-Jāthiya · al-Aḥqāf
حُمَّ الْأَمْرُ وَجَاءَ النَّصْرُ فَعَلَيْنَا لَا يُنْصَرُونَ ❁
Ḥumma’l-amru wa jāʾa’n-naṣru fa-ʿalaynā lā yunṣarūn.
The matter is decreed and the help has come; against us they will not be helped.

﴿ حمٓ ❁ تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ ❁ غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلْعِقَابِ ذِى ٱلطَّوْلِ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ❁ ﴾ Q 40 : 1 – 3
Ḥā Mīm. Tanzīlu’l-kitābi mina’llāhi’l-ʿAzīzi’l-ʿAlīm. Ghāfiri’dh-dhanbi wa qābili’t-tawbi shadīdi’l-ʿiqābi dhi’ṭ-ṭawl. Lā ilāha illā huwa, ilayhi’l-maṣīr.

Ḥā Mīm. The sending down of the Book is from Allāh, the Mighty, the All-Knowing — Forgiver of sin, Accepter of repentance, severe in retribution, Possessor of bounty. There is no god but He; to Him is the journey's end.
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ بَابُنَا ❁
تَبَارَكَ حِيطَانُنَا ❁
يسٓ سَقْفُنَا ❁
كٓهيعٓصٓ كِفَايَتُنَا ❁
حمٓ عٓسٓقٓ حِمَايَتُنَا ❁
Bismi’llāhi bābunā · tabāraka ḥīṭānunā · Yā Sīn saqfunā · Kāf Hā Yā ʿAyn Ṣād kifāyatunā · Ḥā Mīm ʿAyn Sīn Qāf ḥimāyatunā.
In the name of Allāh is our door · “Blessed is He” our walls · Yā Sīn our roof · Kāf Hā Yā ʿAyn Ṣād our sufficiency · Ḥā Mīm ʿAyn Sīn Qāf our protection.
﴿ فَسَيَكْفِيكَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ❁ ﴾ ٣ Q 2 : 137
Fa-sayakfīkahumu’llāh, wa huwa’s-Samīʿu’l-ʿAlīm — three times.
Allāh will suffice you against them; and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
سِتْرُ الْعَرْشِ مَسْبُولٌ عَلَيْنَا ❁ وَعَيْنُ اللَّهِ نَاظِرَةٌ إِلَيْنَا ❁ بِحَوْلِ اللَّهِ لَا يُقْدَرُ عَلَيْنَا ❁
Sitru’l-ʿarshi masbūlun ʿalaynā, wa ʿaynu’llāhi nāẓiratun ilaynā, bi-ḥawli’llāhi lā yuqdaru ʿalaynā.
The veil of the Throne is let down over us; the eye of Allāh is turned toward us; by the power of Allāh none can prevail against us.
﴿ وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌ ❁ بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ ❁ فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍ ❁ ﴾ Q 85 : 20 – 22
Wa’llāhu min warāʾihim muḥīṭ. Bal huwa qurʾānun majīd. Fī lawḥin maḥfūẓ.
And Allāh encompasses them from behind. Rather, it is a glorious Qurʾān, upon a preserved tablet.
﴿ فَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ حَـٰفِظًا ۖ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ ❁ ﴾ ٣ Q 12 : 64
Fa’llāhu khayrun ḥāfiẓan, wa huwa arḥamu’r-rāḥimīn — three times.
Allāh is the best keeper, and He is the most merciful of the merciful.
Seventeen recitations daily · three days · pause at fa’Llāhu khayrun ḥāfiẓan above and repeat it seventeen times
اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ ❁ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ ❁
Allāhumma’kfinī bi-ḥalālika ʿan ḥarāmik, wa aghninī bi-faḍlika ʿamman siwāk.
O Allāh, suffice me with what You have made lawful, so that I need nothing forbidden; and enrich me by Your bounty, so that I need none besides You.
“O God, suffice me through what You have made lawful, so as to free me from what You have forbidden; and enrich me through Your bounty, so as to free me from depending upon any besides You.”
For strife between the reciter and another, or among parties for whom he prays.
﴿ إِنَّ وَلِـِّىَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ۖ وَهُوَ يَتَوَلَّى ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ ❁ ﴾ ٣ Q 7 : 196
Inna waliyyiya’llāhu’lladhī nazzala’l-kitāb, wa huwa yatawalla’ṣ-ṣāliḥīn — three times.
My protector is Allāh, who sent down the Book; and He takes the righteous into His protection.
﴿ حَسْبِىَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ❁ ﴾ ٣ Q 9 : 129
Ḥasbiya’llāhu lā ilāha illā huwa, ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbu’l-ʿarshi’l-ʿaẓīm — three times.
Allāh suffices me; there is no god but He. On Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the mighty Throne.
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ ❁ ٣
Bismi’llāhi’lladhī lā yaḍurru maʿa’smihī shayʾun fi’l-arḍi wa lā fi’s-samāʾi wa huwa’s-Samīʿu’l-ʿAlīm — three times.
In the name of Allāh, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can do harm; and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
Twelve recitations daily · twelve days · pause here and repeat the phrase seventeen times. Morning and evening, seven each, slowly and with deliberation.
﴿ وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ❁ ﴾
Wa nunazzilu mina’l-qurʾāni mā huwa shifāʾun wa raḥmatun li’l-muʾminīn.
And We send down of the Qurʾān that which is a healing and a mercy for the believers.
“And We send down of the Qurʾān that which is healing and mercy for the believers.” — Q 17:82
Then say: “Yā Shāfī, grant healing to so-and-so son of so-and-so , from every illness and from the duration of the affliction.”
For oneself or for another. At the completion of the practice, hold a daʿwah; and on returning home, recite the duʿāʾ once within the house itself, that the blessing be sealed upon it.
وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ ❁ ٣
Wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā bi’llāhi’l-ʿAliyyi’l-ʿAẓīm — three times.
There is no power and no strength except by Allāh, the Most High, the Immense.
﴿ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ ❁ وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ ❁ وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ❁ ﴾ Q 37 : 180 – 182
Subḥāna rabbika rabbi’l-ʿizzati ʿammā yaṣifūn. Wa salāmun ʿala’l-mursalīn. Wa’l-ḥamdu li’llāhi rabbi’l-ʿālamīn.
Glory to your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe. And peace be upon the messengers. And praise belongs to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
After the Ḥizb
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النُّورِ الذَّاتِيِّ وَالسِّرِّ السَّارِيِّ فِي سَائِرِ الْأَسْمَاءِ وَالصِّفَاتِ ❁
Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin, an-nūri’dh-dhātiyyi wa’s-sirri’s-sāriyyi fī sāʾiri’l-asmāʾi wa’ṣ-ṣifāt.
O Allāh, bless our master Muḥammad, and grant him peace and blessing — the light of the Essence, and the secret running through all the Names and Attributes.
